reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` against `main`:

*CRITICAL — Deduplication uses object identity instead of contact ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` keeps distinct objects with the same `id`, so `mergeImports` retains overlapping contacts. This violates the documented first-seen-per-ID behavior.

*Recommended fix:* Track seen `contact.id` values and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add a regression test using separate objects with equal IDs, including across two import lists.

*Verification:* All 4 existing tests pass, but an additional in-memory check fails for both `dedupe([first, later])` and `mergeImports([first], [later])` when both contacts have `id: 1`. The existing test, `test/dedupe.test.js` → “the same object is not repeated,” only covers repeated references to one object.

No other findings. No files changed.
